name: Ashtanga Yoga Nicosia
reason: Too thin: its own site (ashtangayoganicosia.com, Squarespace; robots.txt allows us) shows only the Mysore and Saturday led timetable, moon days, guidelines and teacher pages; no prices, its happenings page is an empty template ("No blog posts yet"), and there are no workshops, trainings or free resources. Founded 2016 by Arita Kriticou Potamitou, described there as the first Cypriot authorised teacher; email arita@ashtangayoganicosia.com.
